255 | def report(stats, t_end, t_read, n_windows, n_files, device) -> None:
256 |     """Timing on stderr. The scan time runs from the first model being loaded (on the
257 |     device) to the results being written, without the time spent loading any later model."""
258 |     scan = t_end - stats[0]["start"] - sum(s["load"] for s in stats[1:])
259 |     e = lambda *x: print(*x, file=sys.stderr)
260 |     e("\n--- scan stats ---")
261 |     gpu = torch.cuda.get_device_name() if device == "cuda" else "CPU"
262 |     e(f"device            {gpu}")
263 |     e(f"files / windows   {n_files:,} / {n_windows:,}   (read and cut before loading: {t_read:.2f} s)")
264 |     for s in stats:
265 |         L = sorted(s["lengths"])
266 |         per = sorted(t / n for t, n in s["batch_times"])
267 |         e(f"[{s['run']}]")
268 |         e(f"  model load      {s['load']:.2f} s (not in the scan time)")
269 |         e(f"  tokens          {s['tokens']:,} (mean {s['tokens'] / len(L):,.0f}, median {statistics.median(L):,.0f}, "
270 |           f"max {L[-1]:,} per window; {s['truncated']} truncated at the limit)")
271 |         e(f"  padding         {s['padded'] - s['tokens']:,} tokens ({1 - s['tokens'] / s['padded']:.1%} of what was computed)")
272 |         e(f"  tokenize        {s['tokenize']:.2f} s")
273 |         e(f"  score           {s['score']:.2f} s in {s['batches']} batches "
274 |           f"({len(L) / s['score']:.1f} windows/s, {s['tokens'] / s['score']:,.0f} tokens/s)")
275 |         e(f"  per window      mean {1000 * s['score'] / len(L):.1f} ms; by batch: median {1000 * statistics.median(per):.1f} ms, "
276 |           f"p95 {1000 * per[min(len(per) - 1, int(0.95 * len(per)))]:.1f} ms, max {1000 * per[-1]:.1f} ms")
277 |         if s["oom_retries"]:
278 |             e(f"  out of memory   {s['oom_retries']} batches retried one window at a time")
279 |     e(f"scan time         {scan:.2f} s after the model was loaded ({n_windows / scan:.1f} windows/s, "
280 |       f"{n_files / scan:.1f} files/s)")
281 |     if device == "cuda":
282 |         e(f"peak GPU memory   {torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 2**30:.2f} GiB allocated, "
283 |           f"{torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved() / 2**30:.2f} GiB reserved")
